card.name: Partway through multiword drug terms
card.fires_on: Fires on a word or word piece in the middle of a longer medical term, such as a drug class name or a drug name plus formulation. It sits just before the term's next part, such as porter, -release or toxicity.

modes.label: Inside long class names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a long drug class or receptor name, before the rest of the word.

modes.label: Formulation or qualifier after drug name
modes.description: A qualifier word after a drug name that is followed by release or toxicity wording.
